decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers build directly on the firm's core heat transfer and tube manufacturing know-how, and its ongoing service work gives it the related knowledge to interpret results and keep improving the product, so it fits the established air cooler business.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are a core component technology across the firm's exchanger types, where its engineering knowledge and R&D can turn field feedback into improvements, so keeping the product strengthens absorptive capacity rather than draining resources.
